description: This file defines a Next.js page component for the 'Explore Roles' feature, including UI components, data fetching logic, filter handling, and presentation of role search results and recommendations.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Concatenates base URL and path, ensuring proper slashes.

methods.name: safeParseSalaryUsdRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses salary range strings, converts USD to INR lakhs, and returns min and max in lakhs.

methods.name: mapSearchRowToUiRole
methods.description: Transforms a backend search row into a UI Role object, including salary parsing and report handling.

methods.name: mapRecommendationToUiRole
methods.description: Converts a RecommendedRole into a UI Role object, mainly for recommendations display.
